main.description: Revoke an OAuth client's access to a space, or ensure it isn't granted. Caller must have the manager role on the space. If this removes the space's last appAccess grant, the space reverts to open access.

clientId.description: The OAuth client_id (client metadata document URL) to revoke access from.

errors.name: InvalidClientId
errors.description: clientId is too long to address as a record key.
